purpose: Observe actual public multilingual Google/Bing state without submitting URLs or exposing private metrics.

liveCollection.result: Google/live public checks completed; Bing partial after a bounded retry; host throttling remains.
liveCollection.privateEvidence: Three new mode-600 JSON snapshots outside all repository checkouts; no private query rows, API keys, Google/Bing performance totals or individual index states in Git.

review.method: Self AI code review and mocked transport regression tests; not independent or human review.
changesAfterLiveObservation: Preserve numeric Bing error codes without logging raw error bodies or credential-bearing request URLs.
Run Bing URL reads sequentially and stop remaining requests on user/host throttling.
Retry only failed current public Bing URLs; preserve original Google/performance/public response timestamps and earlier errors.
Do not treat successful-but-empty Google inspection or an API error as lost indexing.
limitations: The original full live run preceded final throttle-stop handling; the final handling was validated with isolated mocks.
Do not infer Bing index membership from crawl date, IsPage, HTTP status or document size.
No new browser tests; public content, UI and site templates unchanged.

publication: Draft PR only; no merge, deployment, indexing request or sitemap submission.
